e.title: MortalityGaps
e.summary: 双缺口预期寿命预测模型（CRAN 1.0.7）：国家间预期寿命关联预测
e.summary_en: Double-Gap life expectancy forecasting (CRAN 1.0.7): cross-country correlated LE forecasting
e.summary_hk: 雙缺口預期壽命預測模型（CRAN 1.0.7）：國家間預期壽命關聯預測
e.body:
MortalityGaps（CRAN 1.0.7）实现双缺口（Double-Gap）预期寿命预测模型：利用国家间预期寿命的高度时间相关性（领先国 vs 追赶国）预测——Bohk-Ewald 等方法。对 RIAA：长寿预测的跨国视角——单一国家预测易偏，双缺口模型利用「领先-追赶」结构（[[mortalitylaws]]/[[demography]] 之外）；与 [[ledecomp]]（预期寿命分解）配套；适合长寿风险与跨国比较方向。

## 同类工具
[[mortalitytablemaker-container]]、[[motor-claims-simulation-rcpp]]、[[motor-pricing-evt-xl]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
MortalityGaps (CRAN 1.0.7) implements the Double-Gap life expectancy forecasting model: exploiting the strong temporal correlation of life expectancy across countries (leaders vs catch-up) — methods like Bohk-Ewald. For RIAA: the cross-country view of longevity forecasting — single-country forecasts are biased, the double-gap model exploits leader-catch-up structure (beyond [[mortalitylaws]]/[[demography]]); pairs with [[ledecomp]] (life expectancy decomposition); suits longevity risk and cross-country comparison.

## Similar tools
[[mortalitytablemaker-container]]、[[motor-claims-simulation-rcpp]]、[[motor-pricing-evt-xl]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_hk:
MortalityGaps（CRAN 1.0.7）實現雙缺口（Double-Gap）預期壽命預測模型：利用國家間預期壽命的高度時間相關性（領先國 vs 追趕國）預測——Bohk-Ewald 等方法。對 RIAA：長壽預測的跨國視角——單一國家預測易偏，雙缺口模型利用「領先-追趕」結構（[[mortalitylaws]]/[[demography]] 之外）；與 [[ledecomp]]（預期壽命分解）配套；適合長壽風險與跨國比較方向。

## 同類工具
